solution_steps: Ա, Բ, Ե ճիշտ են։ Գ սխալ է՝ ճիշտ է «Do you think we should postpone the daily check-in?»։ Դ սխալ է՝ tag-ը՝ «won't he?»։
statements: Ա) Why did he say he was worried about the medicine shortage?
Բ) Did Sara examine fewer patients than Jeff this month?
Գ) Do you think should we postpone the daily check-in?
Դ) He will surely appreciate the internship, won't it?
Ե) Has Lucy finalized the clinic upgrade?

questions.question: Choose the correctly formulated questions.
questions.hint: Check the form of the question tags and the use of «did» with «used to».
solution_steps: Բ, Գ and Ե are correct. Ա is wrong: the tag should be «is there?». Դ is wrong: after «did» it should be «use to».
statements: Ա) There's no reason to doubt the maintenance log, was there?
Բ) I am confident that the maintenance log is airworthy, aren't I?
Գ) Which aircraft do you inspect most often?
Դ) Did you used to work as an apprentice mechanic when you started?
Ե) Was it you or the apprentice mechanic who replaced the component?
